said its V2X Systems unit won a contract modification worth up to $231.8M for base support services under the Iraq F-16 program.
The modification lifts the contract’s total value to $594.2M, from $362.4M previously.
The work will be performed at Martyr BG Ali Flaih Air Base in Iraq and is expected to continue through July 17, 2027.
A total of $115.9M in FMS funds will be obligated at the time of the award.
The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center is the contracting activity.

title: V2X Systems wins up to $231.8M Iraq F-16 support contract boost
